category_title: Male preschool children who report physical peer aggression
scenario_title: Reporting physical aggression and property disputes during joint play
minimal_context: The student is participating in daily preschool activities and joint play with peers using materials like scissors, paintbrushes, and blocks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for joint play. You can build a tower with the blocks or use the scissors and paintbrushes at the art table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: She’s not finished yet with the paintbrush; she won’t hurry up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: See if you can find something else to do for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He won’t let me have the scissors.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to share with your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (To peer) I’m telling the teacher! (To tutor) Matthew, he’s knocking down the tower! He tried to bited me!
